policy: These are proposed additional/clarifying operational inputs, not changes to the deployed form. Reuse existing equivalent typed operational questions after an explicit mapping. Ask only applicable prompts, scoped to business/activity/offering/location as stated; missing is unknown, false is a valid answer. Applicability prose compiles to the existing bounded condition AST; no second evaluator or scripts.

questions.prompt: Can customers book this offering for an agreed time or period?
questions.effect: Enable configured reservation intake only after all required model setup and authority checks; false preserves appropriate non-booking workflow.

questions.prompt: Do you accept scheduled bookings for this service?
questions.effect: Separate optional or unavailable scheduling from advance booking being mandatory.

questions.prompt: Must customers book before arriving?
questions.effect: Determine permitted walk-in versus advance intake without silently removing optional bookings.

questions.prompt: Can customers reserve this optional service alongside the main purchase?
questions.effect: Only the selected consultation, fitting, installation or intake creates linked booking work once.

questions.prompt: How should booking requests be accepted?
questions.effect: Select lifecycle and confirmation wording; instant mode requires actual reservation support and complete setup.

questions.prompt: How many minutes does this service take?
questions.effect: Use exact validated duration, never an average inferred from a legacy band.

questions.prompt: What minimum and maximum hire or occupancy periods do you allow?
questions.effect: Explicit time/date unit, min/max and billing period; enforce offering limits within bounded platform ceiling.

questions.prompt: Which people, spaces or assets can fulfil this offering?
questions.effect: Resolve actual eligible identified resources, inventory and authority; fleet-count bands are not resource lists.

questions.prompt: When are these resources available?
questions.effect: Use Africa/Nairobi intervals, breaks, overnight shifts and closures; missing setup is not unlimited availability.

questions.prompt: How much capacity is available for this session, window or period?
questions.effect: Define exact quantity, unit, precision and capacity authority; distinguish places, workload, weight, volume, area and identified assets.

questions.prompt: How much setup, cleanup or turnaround time is needed?
questions.effect: Reserve configured boundaries without changing the agreed customer duration silently.

questions.prompt: How soon and how far ahead can customers book?
questions.effect: Exact lead/horizon units and local cutoffs; broad existing bands need confirmation.

questions.prompt: Where and how is this offering fulfilled?
questions.effect: Enable only actual methods; customer-location visits need coverage/travel, remote methods need no fictitious room.

questions.prompt: Which areas can your team serve and what travel allowance is needed?
questions.effect: Validate compatible route/coverage and travel feasibility; do not invent a guaranteed emergency ETA.

questions.prompt: Does this meet-and-greet include transport?
questions.effect: Choose greeter-only versus joint eligible vehicle/driver allocation.

questions.prompt: Can customers choose a delivery or collection window?
questions.effect: Optional typed fulfilment-window capacity; ordinary purchase still creates no appointment.

questions.prompt: Which delivery or collection windows can you actually promise?
questions.effect: Specify real window duration, capacity, cutoff and authority only when scheduled fulfilment is enabled.

questions.prompt: Does this activity repeat on a regular schedule?
questions.effect: Repeated occurrences/orders have separate confirmed state and exception handling; no automatic membership or recurring debit.

questions.prompt: Which dates should repeat and when should the series end?
questions.effect: Kenya local recurrence with end/count and occurrence-level changes; ask only if recurring scheduling is enabled.

questions.prompt: Do you sell a membership or retainer with defined access or credits?
questions.effect: Require actual plan scope/validity and separate payment consent before enabling commercial entitlement or renewal.

questions.prompt: What access, visits or credits does the plan include?
questions.effect: Plan rights and actual booking allocations remain separate; atomically consume credits when relevant.

questions.prompt: Can customers reserve a table or space through this offering?
questions.effect: Explicit intent, distinct from reservation_system discovery; require actual space inventory, authority and policy.

questions.prompt: Which tables or spaces fit each party size, and can they be combined?
questions.effect: Reserve compatible spaces together with duration/turnover and exact party bounds.

questions.prompt: Is this made for the customer or sourced from another supplier?
questions.effect: Production commitments only for actual custom creation; special sourcing of books uses request/quote and stock authority.

questions.prompt: What preparation, approval and capacity are needed before the due date?
questions.effect: Exact lead time/workload/cutoff and accepted specification, not a fictitious appointment duration.

questions.prompt: Which collection and return times can be supported together?
questions.effect: Feasible linked promise with real transport only when selected, processing and turnaround capacity.

questions.prompt: Which parts need another provider to confirm them?
questions.effect: Keep supplier-dependent work pending until actual confirmation; inclusion text is not an allocation.

questions.prompt: Which system confirms reservations for these resources?
questions.effect: No external write until real authorization and capability validation; shared mode needs explicit field/command ownership and conflict rules.

questions.prompt: What payment is required before this request or booking is confirmed?
questions.effect: Supported configured no-prepayment/deposit/prepayment/approved later-payment, price in KES and owner reference; no provider credentials in answers.

questions.prompt: What changes or cancellations do you allow?
questions.effect: Per-offering notice/approval/fee/refund rules enforced by NEXG command policy and retained for accepted work.

questions.prompt: Would you like to connect a separate Google calendar for this business?
questions.effect: Preference starts an authorization journey; does not itself connect, grant access or publish personal event details.

corrections.interpretation: Advance booking mandatory, not automatically whether optional bookings are accepted.
A false clinic answer must suppress appointment promises unless a separately confirmed offering enables them.
Existing system discovery only; no table booking activation or authorization.
Clarify actual creation versus sourcing, especially books.
Recurring schedule, not automatic commercial membership or debit.
Recurring fulfilment/schedule and commercial entitlement are separately confirmed.
Discovery band is not actual resource inventory or free capacity.
Venue size is not a table map and does not enable reservations.
